_about: Howard Pyle (1853-1911), the books he wrote (most he also illustrated): Robin Hood, the four King Arthur books, the fairy-tale collections (Pepper & Salt, The Wonder Clock, Twilight Land, The Garden Behind the Moon), the historical novels and the pirate stories. Books by others that Pyle only illustrated are excluded. Gutenberg clean text; one Internet Archive OCR volume. US public domain.

pyle-robin-hood: The Merry Adventures of Robin Hood (1883)
pyle-pepper-and-salt: Pepper & Salt, or Seasoning for Young Folk (1886)
pyle-wonder-clock: The Wonder Clock (1888), verses by Katharine Pyle
pyle-jack-ballister: The Story of Jack Ballister's Fortunes (1895)
pyle-rejected-of-men: Rejected of Men: A Story of To-day (1903)
pyle-king-arthur: The Story of King Arthur and His Knights (1903)
pyle-champions-round-table: The Story of the Champions of the Round Table (1905)
pyle-sir-launcelot: The Story of Sir Launcelot and His Companions (1907)
pyle-grail-passing-of-arthur: The Story of the Grail and the Passing of Arthur (1910)
pyle-book-of-pirates: Howard Pyle's Book of Pirates (1921, compiled by Merle Johnson)

_excluded.pyle-duplicates: Robin Hood PG 10148, Twilight Land PG 1751, Book of Pirates PG 26862: second transcriptions
_excluded.pyle-illustrator-only: books by others that Pyle illustrated: Dulcibel (Peterson), Grandmother's Story and The One Hoss Shay (Holmes), Chivalry (Cabell), The Island of Enchantment (Forman), Captain Ravenshaw (Stephens), Sir Christopher (Goodwin), A Story of the Golden Age (Baldwin), Hugh Wynne (Mitchell) and others
_excluded.pyle-edited: The Buccaneers and Marooners of America (PG 73564): Exquemelin and Johnson's texts, Pyle as editor
_excluded.pyle-not-pyle: That Marvel — The Movie (PG 66368): by Edward S. Van Zile; the catalogue match is a false hit
_excluded.pyle-pending: PENDING: Yankee Doodle (1881), The Story of the Revolution (Pyle's Book of the American Spirit, 1923 compilation), the magazine stories never collected
